resolved_conflicts.explanation: Inferred from the matching 1934 date and the missing elevation: the Forest Service row six miles south of Powell RS (built 1934, elevation given as ?) is the tower this record describes. The row three miles north of Lochsa RS (built 1933, 5000 ft) is a different tower, and the two should not be merged with this record.

notes_for_editor: Two Grouse Points sit on the Clearwater. This record (FFLA 46.41048, -114.69014) matches the Forest Service row six miles south of Powell RS (built 1934, burned 1934). The 1933 tower three miles north of Lochsa RS is the subject of us-id-grouse-point-2 and -3. The dedupe review kept -2 and -3 apart at 3.0 km; the sources (FS row, firelookout grousepoint269 at -115.33464, Idaho St. Joe page at -115.3426) suggest they are one tower, which the owner should confirm. Coordinates differ: FFLA 46.41048,-114.69014 vs Idaho Selway 46.41076,-114.67777 (949 m). Idaho's Selway page gives elevation as ????, as the FS list does. The brief's 'destroyed' event is corrected to 'burned'. The owner's brief shows a 1934 event only; this research adds the 1934 built event. No staffing or fire history beyond the Pete King burn was found. Page reads ran one over the per-tower budget (seven) because two of them were needed to separate the two Grouse Points.
